description: A React component for displaying and searching through a list of channels with filtering, pagination, and join functionality in the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: SearchableChannelList
classes.description: A React component that renders a searchable, filterable, and paginated list of channels with join capabilities.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with incoming props, particularly for search mode and pagination.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets focus on the search input on desktop and adds keydown event listener.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events, particularly Enter key presses for accessibility.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Handles joining a channel and closing modal if already a member.

methods.name: isMemberOfChannel
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a member of a specific channel.

methods.name: createChannelRow
methods.description: Creates a JSX element representing a channel row with details and join/view button.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the previous page of channels.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Performs search based on current input value.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change in the search box.

methods.name: handleChecked
methods.description: Toggles the preference to hide joined channels.

methods.name: getEmptyStateMessage
methods.description: Returns a message component when no channels are found.

methods.name: getFilterLabel
methods.description: Returns label for current filter type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire component including search input, filter dropdown, channel list, and pagination controls.
